text: The rural property experienced a tree-cover loss of approximately 81.3 hectares in 2021, which accounts for about 2.23% of the total asset area of 3643.5 hectares. The affected area was predominantly planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. The loss was mapped by Hansen/UMD and corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which agreed on 98% of the event area. However, it's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it was legal or authorized.
